name: Evil Life
source:
The protagonist accidentally is introduced in a game world. There he will encounter various girls and women from different areas. They can be school teachers, company managers, or bar attendants.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Leoleon]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
主角意外进入了游戏世界，在那里遇见来自不同领域的女孩与女性。她们可能是学校教师、公司经理，也可能是酒吧服务员。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Leoleon]Patreon[/url]]
